scope: Public RC provider and destination descriptor path; static source evidence, no pixel layout or completed frame claim
address_convention: All K addresses are raw ARM64 file offsets, KVA=raw+ffffffc001000000; never CP+108000

destination.labels: T=builder input x2, J=command output, B=prepared backing; these are local names, not original structure types
destination.copy: 0x2d7de0..0x2d7dec copies 0x60 descriptor bytes T+0x90 -> J+0x98; no image pixels are copied
destination.selector: Mask 0x282 separates {1,7,9} for alignment checks; actual inherited 1054 selector and byte-order meaning remain unknown
destination.preparation: 0x2d8968..0x2d8984 calls 0x2cd23c; its returned value later becomes x4 of 0x2cdc94
destination.records: 0x2d8b40..0x2d8b84 copies destination records to B+i*0x88+0x20 and B+i*0x30+0x8a00
destination.submission: 0x2d8eb4..0x2d8ed0 calls 0x2d4588 with hardware object, both destination records, u32[J+0x108], u32[J+0x110]
